auth.subhead: AI-powered multimodal vision inspection enforcing Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 with sub-millimeter precision.
auth.feature1_desc: Automated verification against Table-I minimum numeral heights (1.0 mm to 6.0 mm) with physical reference scale calibration.
auth.feature2_desc: Rules 6(1), 7, 8, 9, 13 SI units, and Second Schedule prescribed package size validation preventing deceptive packaging.
auth.feature3_desc: Generates formal Legal Metrology violation reports and notice dossiers compliant with Section 15 & Section 39.

scan.title: Inspect & Audit Packaged Commodity
scan.subtitle: Upload multi-panel packaging photos or capture live in the field to audit compliance against LMR 2011.
scan.dropzone_title: Drag and drop panel images, or click to browse
scan.dropzone_subtitle: Supports PNG, JPG, WEBP up to 20MB per panel
scan.panel_tip: Capture multiple panels: Front (PDP), Back, Sides, Crimp/Base
scan.scale_hint: Enter known reference width in mm for Table-I font height calculation
scan.notes_placeholder: e.g. Seized from Retailer X, Ward 4, Batch Verification Required
scan.qr_card_desc: This packaging directs consumers to an external manufacturer portal to resolve the physical manufacturing premises. Open the official manufacturer portal below, enter the batch code, and upload a screenshot of the factory address to complete statutory verification.
scan.qr_step4_desc: If the portal is inaccessible or you wish to proceed without digital verification, you can skip this step. The manufacturer declaration will be flagged for physical manual inspection.
scan.qr_batch_present_option: Batch code is present on package
scan.qr_batch_absent_option: No batch code present on package
scan.qr_no_batch_desc: Packaging mandates verification via manufacturer portal, but no batch code is present on the package to enter into the portal. Confirming will skip online portal verification and record manufacturer details as NEEDS_MANUAL_INSPECTION with code NO_BATCH_CODE_ON_PACKAGE.
scan.qr_no_batch_btn: Confirm: No Batch Code on Pack & Resume
scan.qr_batch_reference_hint: Please verify against the physical package and portal prompt. Different portals may require the full code, the first 3 characters, or the last 3 characters.
scan.qr_batch_low_confidence: Batch code detected with low confidence — please verify against the physical package.
scan.qr_batch_input_placeholder: Enter batch code for portal (e.g. 02D42, D42, BP3)
scan.qr_screenshot_hint: After entering the code and viewing the manufacturer details, take a screenshot and upload it below.
scan.qr_no_batch_result_title: Rule 6(1)(a) Physical Inspection Required (No Batch Code on Package)
scan.second_schedule_title: Second Schedule Prescribed Pack Size Audit
scan.second_schedule_desc: Evaluates package quantity against Schedule II prescribed standard denominations under Rule 5.

report.subtitle: Official Legal Metrology Form generated under Section 15 of Legal Metrology Act, 2009.
report.official_language_note: Statutory Record Notice: Formal PDF and Word (.docx) compliance reports are generated in English to maintain uniform legal and evidentiary standards under LMR 2011.
report.sec5_title: 5. Second Schedule Prescribed Pack Size Audit (Anti-Shrinkflation)
report.sec6_title: 6. Statutory Violations & Enforcement Penalties (Legal Metrology Act, 2009)
report.sec6_clean_banner: Nil Infractions Recorded: All mandatory packaging declarations comply strictly with the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011. No statutory penalties under Section 36(1) or Section 39 applicable.
report.modal_evidence_subtitle: Upload additional photographic evidence or field inspection notes to attach to the official dossier.
report.modal_evidence_notes_placeholder: e.g. Package inspected at distributor godown. Physical crimp verified with micrometer.
report.badge_explanatory_notice: Statutory Notice on Evidentiary Badges: Fields marked with the amber [Manual Edit] badge represent statutory declaration values physically verified, inspected, and updated by the authorized enforcement officer, superseding automated AI extractions under the Legal Metrology Act, 2009. Fields without this badge represent automated multimodal extractions.
